Community fan character — not an official DeepSeek character or endorsement.

Changes: Original114 transparent videos are bundled unchanged. A front-view transparent
poster was mechanically derived from the upstream character sheet. Animation config is
reused as data. CareerPilot implements its own Vue launcher,300ms long-press dragging,
viewport constraints, optional slow roaming, action menu and original assistant binding.
The “AI Chatbot” badge is a separate webpage overlay; original animation imagery is unchanged.
No upstream desktop runtime, anonymous local API, account balance, weather, notifications,
standalone chat backend, paid idle speech or original credential configuration is included.

Files and SHA256: manifest.json. Acquisition: scripts/acquire-dsh-pet.mjs in project source.
Any commercial reuse requires replacing the character assets or obtaining separate permission.
